description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of samples across different reasoning categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “Mathematical Reasoning”, “General Reasoning”, “Natural Scene Reasoning”, “Physical Reasoning”, “Logical Reasoning”, and “Chemical Reasoning”, listed in a left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Samples”, employs a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10⁴, with tick labels at intervals of powers of 10, and units are not explicitly stated. Six light blue bars represent the number of samples for each category; the “Mathematical Reasoning” bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 7025 samples, while the “Chemical Reasoning” bar is the shortest, at approximately 49 samples. The “General Reasoning” bar reaches approximately 1709 samples, “Natural Scene Reasoning” reaches approximately 413 samples, “Physical Reasoning” reaches approximately 232 samples, and “Logical Puzzle Reasoning” reaches approximately 91 samples. No bars are visually emphasized, and the bars are arranged in descending order based on their height.
